instruction: Use the opened OpenStudio application and its CLI/API automation interface to organize /home/user/Desktop/init.osm and save the updated model as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process OSM text outside the OpenStudio environment. The current model is a low single-story office building with an intact flat roof. The owner wants an energy retrofit model with roof-mounted photovoltaic generation without changing the exterior wall or roof geometry. Keep the simple single-office mass, complete the office loads and comfort settings, and use the roof as the support for a south-facing roof-conformal photovoltaic array connected through a reasonable PVWatts inverter and load center. Deliver only the updated OpenStudio model file; object handles, serialization order, and automatically generated metadata may vary naturally. Exact reproducible acceptance specification (SI units; geometry coordinates and lengths are metres; areas are square metres; names are exact): {"building":"CLI PV Office","stories":[{"name":"01_PV","z":0}],"spaces":[{"name":"PV-OFFICE","zone":"PV-OFFICE Zone","x0":0,"y0":0,"x1":18,"y1":10,"z0":0,"h":3.6,"story":"01_PV","space_type":"TASK07 PV Office Type","heat":20,"cool":25,"ideal":true}],"constant_schedules":{"TASK07 Occupancy Schedule":0.65,"TASK07 Load Schedule":1},"space_types":{"TASK07 PV Office Type":{"people":0.035,"people_schedule":"TASK07 Occupancy Schedule","lights":8,"lights_schedule":"TASK07 Load Schedule","equipment":12,"equipment_schedule":"TASK07 Load Schedule"}},"pv":{"distribution":"TASK07 PV Load Center","operation":"Baseload","bus":"DirectCurrentWithInverter","inverter":{"name":"TASK07 PVWatts Inverter","dc_to_ac":1.15,"efficiency":0.96},"generators":[{"name":"TASK07 Roof PVWatts","surface_space":"PV-OFFICE","surface":"roof","capacity":18000,"module":"Premium","array":"FixedOpenRack","losses":0.12,"azimuth":180}]},"metrics":{"bbox":[18,10,3.6],"floor_area":180,"exterior_wall_area":201.6,"surface_count":6,"space_count":1,"zone_count":1,"story_count":1,"window_count":0,"window_area":0,"shading_count":0,"shading_area":0,"paired_surface_count":0,"ground_floor_count":1}}. Attach each PVWatts generator to its specified roof surface, include every generator in the named load center's generator list, and connect the named inverter to that load center. In OpenStudio surface-attached PVWatts mode, array tilt is inherited from the supporting planar surface and is not an independent required field.
